reason: The model customer mislabeled repeated demands as non-pushbacks, then exceeded the allowed count. Generated self-labels do not reliably enforce a reply budget.
new_rule: Every nonterminal model-customer reply on a pressure case consumes one of two follow-ups. After two, the controller closes without another customer model call. This includes information or confirmation replies and is an explicitly tighter interaction horizon.
comparison_limit: This version changes the customer horizon. Do not combine it with older cohorts as an unchanged treatment. Scripted and model customers retain distinct mechanisms.
scope: Necessary engineering validation within the approved pilot ceiling; not the full study.
